metadata.title: When Valorant gave me 2 kills and I’m still confused if I’m a bot or a God
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just accidentally flex?
Enemy must’ve been busy questioning their life choices.
Valorant logic handing out freebies like a confused uncle.
Click if your kills feel like pure, dumb luck!
